The test image shows a very young seedling at soil level that is brown, collapsed, and rotted — consistent with pre/post-emergence damping off. The cotyledons are brown and dead, with soft rot apparent at/below the soil line.

The Pythium damping-off reference shows the same characteristic pattern: brown rotted hypocotyls, collapsed seedlings at soil level in moist/wet dark soil, with the seedling failing to establish. This matches the test image well.

Key matches:
- Seedling collapse at soil level
- Brown rotted tissue (hypocotyl/cotyledons)
- Wet, dark soil environment
- Pre/early post-emergence failure to establish
